idea: Medical and dental scrubs and clinic uniforms with logo embroidery (Turkish-made)
local_sellers: Mediclo (foreign Shopify store with an Albania storefront priced in lek), scrub top Lek 2,000 on sale (regular Lek 3,300), https://mediclo.com/en-al
ApparelnBags (US-based online, Tirana landing page, no lek price), https://www.apparelnbags.com/lp/medical-scrubs-coats-tirana-albania.htm
CityTex, Petrele/Tirana: local garment maker listing uniforms and workwear (no price), https://www.goafricaonline.com/al/directory/fashion-clothing-textiles
demand_evidence: 18,000+ Italian patients at Albanian dental clinics, +45% vs 2024, https://www.alfapress.al/english/ekonomi/italianet-shpenzuan-60-milione-euro-ne-klinikat-dentare-te-shqiperise-sh-i183879
109 dentistry clinics in Albania in one directory (commercial source), https://en.bookimed.com/clinics/country=albania/direction=dentistry
note: 4 searches (Albanian + English, shops, Instagram) found no local scrubs shop, only foreign webshops; but Albania has 875+ garment firms (PEA) that could sew them, so gap rated 'available'. Temu sells cheap scrubs; win on clinic-branded sets and re-orders. Merrjep could not be fetched (unverified). Not a medical device.

local_sellers: No Albanian seller found in 5 searches (Albanian, English, Italian, Stihl); Stihl sells SP 92/SPA 65 olive harvesters but its dealer finder shows no confirmed Albanian dealer (unverified), https://www.stihl.com/local-stihl-representative.aspx
Reference price outside Albania: Campagnola Alice Eco on ManoMano Italy, https://www.manomano.it/p/abbacchiatore-olive-campagnola-alice-eco-con-asta-telescopica-in-alluminio-185270cm-67680173
demand_evidence: Olive output 143,383 t in 2025; Fier, Elbasan, Berat, Vlore = 83.2% (INSTAT), https://www.instat.gov.al/media/j5ffa5pu/agriculture-statistics-2025.pdf
